probe.scope: CPU-only compiler mechanism probe; hypothetical pointer alignment is not an admitted ABI and no GPU result is claimed

observation: The retained optimized kernels have no pointer tt.divisibility attributes in TTGIR and scalar b16 PTX memory instructions. 002 already emits .cg for its streamed inputs, so another input-cache-hint change would not test this gap. In three CPU-only compilations, holding the retained program, target and compile options fixed while hypothetically adding tt.divisibility=16 to pointer arguments changes sizePerThread from 1 to 8 and changes scalar b16 loads/stores to v4.b32 vector operations. Static load/store instruction counts change from 24/8 to 3/1 in 001 and 002, and from 64/32 to 8/4 in 025. CUDA was not initialized. This demonstrates a code-generation mechanism, not an eightfold runtime speedup or GPU correctness.
proposed_change: Design one evidence-gated pointer-alignment contract across authoring/compile and launch admission, then project admitted facts into ASTSource attrs. Do not hardcode 16-byte alignment for every pointer: contiguous offset views can be unaligned. Preserve the unconstrained ABI until the applicable contract actually guarantees alignment, verify actual input and output addresses, and exercise intentionally unaligned views and lower-alignment cases before adoption. Shared ABI/Compiler changes go through main with complete verification and independent review; fresh B300 correctness and matched timing are required after implementation. No first-class layout algebra is proposed.
promotion_disposition: All three staged runs completed with 7650/7650 complete snapshots passing. Qualified external edges: 001 2.304 versus 2.336 us (close_null); 002 3.008 versus 3.296 us (1.0957x, first_arm_faster); 025 2.720 versus 2.720 us (close_null). Only 001 has a qualified direct old-control gain (1.0833x). The direct control edges for 002/025 fail the unchanged CV gate, so their nominal 1.206x/1.153x gains are descriptive and the overall three-edge reports remain measurement_quality_failed. No blanket promotion or generalization; successor authoring and new profiling are separate work.
